title: Super-agent Borrow Protocol Config v1
description: P0 of the super-agent borrow design (docs/decisions/superagent-borrow-design.md §2, §10). Contracts, validation and fail-closed refusal only: no v1 consumer reads these values yet, every default preserves legacy behaviour, and naming v1 or an owner model without a consumer is PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED at start-up (contracts/superagent-borrow.mjs).

superagentBorrow.description: One protocol position, never four booleans. off = the product as it is today (profile, tool surface, executor choice and budgets are HEAD's). v1 = the four borrowed mechanisms as one version; it requires team/guard/goalCheck true and autonomy/collab on, and it has no consumer before P1-P5.

ownerModel.description: Deployment choice only (§4.2). null keeps the host's current owner model. Set without an entry that can select it, start-up fails instead of silently keeping the heavier model.

intentSemantics.description: §12 records root-decision-v1 on 2026-11-01 via away-mode selection (user may revise). undecided means the deployment has not recorded its selection and blocks v1 activation. silence-pass-m2b is a parseable historical alternative, not supported v1 semantics.
